# GoBuyMe

> GoBuyMe is a Nigerian on-demand delivery marketplace connecting customers with restaurants, grocery stores and pharmacies, delivered by independent riders. It operates in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt and 50+ Nigerian cities, with food delivered in an average of 25 minutes and live GPS order tracking.

GoBuyMe is a three-sided marketplace: customers who order food, groceries and medicine; vendors (restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies) who sell on the platform; and riders who deliver orders.

## For customers
- [Order food, groceries & pharmacy](https://gobuyme.shop/food): Browse and order from 500+ restaurants, stores and pharmacies. Average delivery time 25 minutes for food.
- [Groceries](https://gobuyme.shop/groceries): Grocery and household essentials delivery under the EMART category.
- [Pharmacy](https://gobuyme.shop/pharmacy): Licensed pharmacy partners for medicine and health product delivery.
- [Errands](https://gobuyme.shop/errands): On-demand errand and package delivery.
- Payment: card, bank transfer and USSD via Paystack; cash on delivery in select cities.
- Delivery fee: from ₦500, distance-based, capped at ₦3,000.

## For vendors (restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies)
- [Become a vendor](https://gobuyme.shop/become-a-vendor): List a business on GoBuyMe.
- Commission tiers: Starter (3% per order, no monthly fee) and Growth (7.5% per order, unlocks in-app promotions and boosted placement). No setup fee.
- Multi-branch chains and retail groups get a dedicated multi-branch console and account lead (Empire tier).
- Vendors get a live order dashboard, daily payouts and real-time order status tracking.
- Approval typically completes within 24 hours; first order within ~48 hours of signup.

## For riders
- [Become a rider](https://gobuyme.shop/riders): Sign up to deliver for GoBuyMe.
- Flexible hours, no shifts. Weekly payouts (Fridays) or instant cash-out for a ₦50 fee.
- Free accident and bike insurance on every active trip. Bike lease-to-own financing available from ₦4,500/day.
- Typical earnings: ₦88,000–₦256,000+/month depending on trip volume.
